response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience and notable geospatial project contributions via GISCollective, but lacks direct C++/Rust experience in production routing or geospatial data pipelines, and his resume emphasizes JavaScript/TypeScript/DLang over the required systems-level languages and navigation-specific expertise.
strengths: Built open-source geospatial platform (GISCollective) with real-world NGO use
Demonstrated low-latency systems experience using DLang and async I/O
Strong track record of learning new technologies and contributing across stacks
concerns: No demonstrated professional experience with C++ or Rust in routing or map tile systems
Lacks explicit experience with navigation data pipelines, traffic integration, or routing tile optimization
Primary language focus is JavaScript/TypeScript/DLang, not the required C++/systems programming
